description: This file is a header (.h) file declaring APIs, types, and constants for the RDK IARM-Bus inter-process communication interface. It defines function signatures, macros, and data structures used for initializing, connecting, registering event handlers, broadcasting events, and invoking remote procedure calls within the IARM-Bus platform.
published: IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_BroadcastEvent(const char *ownerName, IARM_EventId_t eventId, void *data, size_t len)
IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_RegisterEventHandler(const char *ownerName, IARM_EventId_t eventId, IARM_EventHandler_t handler)
IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_RemoveEventHandler(const char *ownerName, IARM_EventId_t eventId, IARM_EventHandler_t handler)
IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_Call(const char *ownerName,  const char *methodName, void *arg, size_t argLen)
IARM_Result_t IARM_Bus_Call_with_IPCTimeout(const char *ownerName,  const char *methodName, void *arg, size_t argLen, int timeout)

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Init
methods.description: Initializes the IARM-Bus library and registers the client identified by 'name'. Must be called before connecting to the bus.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Term
methods.description: Terminates the IARM-Bus library and releases resources.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the IARM bus for communication.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the IARM bus, ceasing event reception and RPC invocation.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_BroadcastEvent
methods.description: Publishes an event to all registered listeners.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific member is registered with IARM.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Registers an event handler callback for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_UnRegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Removes all handlers for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RemoveEventHandler
methods.description: Removes a specific handler for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterCall
methods.description: Registers an RPC method implementation identified by a name.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call
methods.description: Invokes a remote procedure call by owner and method name.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call_with_IPCTimeout
methods.description: Invokes a remote procedure call with a specified timeout.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEvent
methods.description: Registers the maximum number of events existing in the application.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_WritePIDFile
methods.description: Writes the process ID to a specified file.
